providerStatus: TinyFish search and fetch_content used to find and read sources; one TinyFish browser run listed Fredun's November 2026 BSE announcements. Exchange and company PDFs were downloaded and searched locally with pypdf.
method: Lesson-editor review of quick, helps, hurts and context claim by claim against each lesson's official sources; checker warnings fixed by rewriting.
scope: hcg, tcs, genus-power, fredun-pharmaceuticals, titan-company, swiggy. Plain-language and source check of pre-financial text; not a financial audit.
financialPolicy: No financial figures, snapshots or financial-review files changed. Recent quarterly results are described in words and percentages only.
